title: Gauss formalizes the Strong Prime Number Theorem in Lean
summary: Math Inc reports that Gauss produced most statements and proofs for a Lean formalization of the strong Prime Number Theorem, with about 25,000 lines and 1,100 theorems/definitions in three weeks. Humans supplied mathematical scaffolding and reviewed strategies, and some files adapt prior work. The date follows the original project blueprint dated 11 September 2025, rather than an inferred announcement timestamp. This verifies a formalization of an existing theorem, not a new theorem.

evidence.tested: A published Lean formalization of the encoded theorem; this review did not compile it.
evidence.unknown: The original dated blueprint and published project/verification context were checked; the Lean project was not rebuilt in this review.
evidence.ai_role: Gauss generated most statements and proofs with human scaffolding and reuse of prior formalization.
